item.title: Depressive and Anxious Symptoms, Experimentally Manipulated Acute Social-Evaluative Threat, and Cortisol
item.description: What it’s about In this paper, we examine depressive and anxious symptoms, experimentally manipulated acute social-evaluative threat, and cortisol. Abstract This paper examines the focal construct and reports empirical and/or psychometric evidence relevant to its interpretation. The findings contribute to the literature by clarifying measurement, theoretical implications, and practical applications in context.
